count_orbits.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits

count_orbits_nongrav_snr3.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits WHERE yarkovsky IS NOT NULL AND yarkovsky_unc > 0 AND ABS(yarkovsky) > 3 * yarkovsky_unc

count_orbits_with_srp.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits WHERE srp IS NOT NULL

count_orbits_with_yarkovsky.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits WHERE yarkovsky IS NOT NULL

count_ss_detection.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection

count_ss_object.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_object

detections_per_object.adql: SELECT ss.ssobjectid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection AS ss GROUP BY ss.ssobjectid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8

group_by_ssobjectid.adql: SELECT ss.ssobjectid, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(ss.ephoffsetalongtrack) AS mean_along FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection AS ss GROUP BY ss.ssobjectid

join_cardinality.adql: SELECT ss.measurement_id, COUNT(*) AS n_matched FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection AS ss JOIN alerce_tap.detection AS d ON d.measurement_id = ss.measurement_id AND d.oid = ss.ssobjectid GROUP BY ss.measurement_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

join_measurement_id.adql: SELECT d.oid, d.sid, d.mjd, d.ra, d.dec, d.band, ss.ssobjectid, ss.designation, ss.ephra, ss.ephdec, ss.ephoffset, ss.ephoffsetra, ss.ephoffsetdec, ss.toporange, ss.heliorange, ss.diadistancerank FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection AS ss JOIN alerce_tap.detection AS d ON d.measurement_id = ss.measurement_id AND d.oid = ss.ssobjectid

join_orbits_to_detections.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ss.ssobjectid FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection AS ss JOIN alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits AS o ON o.ssobjectid = ss.ssobjectid) AS t

oc_from_positions.adql: SELECT d.ra, d.dec, ss.ephra, ss.ephdec, ss.ephoffset, ss.ephoffsetra, ss.ephoffsetdec, ss.topo_vx, ss.topo_vy, ss.topo_vz, ss.toporange FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection AS ss JOIN alerce_tap.detection AS d ON d.measurement_id = ss.measurement_id AND d.oid = ss.ssobjectid WHERE ss.diadistancerank = 1

orbits_epoch_range.adql: SELECT MIN(epoch_mjd) AS lo, MAX(epoch_mjd) AS hi, MIN(arc_length_total) AS arc_lo, MAX(arc_length_total) AS arc_hi FROM alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits

sample_mpc_orbits.adql: SELECT a, q, e, i, node, argperi, peri_time, mean_anomaly, period, mean_motion, a_unc, e_unc, i_unc, h, g, earth_moid, arc_length_total, arc_length_sel, nobs_total, nobs_total_sel, nopp, u_param, not_normalized_rms, normalized_rms, epoch_mjd, orbit_type_int, unpacked_primary_provisional_designation, yarkovsky, yarkovsky_unc, srp, srp_unc, a1, a1_unc, a2, a2_unc, a3, a3_unc, dt, dt_unc FROM alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits

sample_ss_detection.adql: SELECT measurement_id, ssobjectid, designation, ecllambda, eclbeta, gallon, gallat, elongation, phaseangle, toporange, toporangerate, heliorange, heliorangerate, ephra, ephdec, ephvmag, ephrate, ephratera, ephratedec, ephoffset, ephoffsetra, ephoffsetdec, ephoffsetalongtrack, ephoffsetcrosstrack FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection

ss_object_columns.adql: SELECT column_name, datatype FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns WHERE table_name = 'alerce_tap.lsst_ss_object' ORDER BY column_name

ss_offset_with_good_orbit.adql: SELECT ss.designation, ss.ephoffset, ss.ephoffsetalongtrack, o.normalized_rms, o.arc_length_total, o.nopp, o.h FROM alerce_tap.lsst_ss_detection AS ss JOIN alerce_tap.lsst_mpc_orbits AS o ON o.ssobjectid = ss.ssobjectid WHERE o.normalized_rms < 1.5 AND o.nopp >= 3
